title: "Ingest WoRMS — (re)build the spp.duckdb `worms` table from the monthly marinespecies.org DwC-A"
msens:
  target_name: ingest_worms
  workflow_type: ingest
  dependency: []
  output: data/manifests/ingest_worms.json
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console

Rebuild the `worms` taxonomy table in **`spp.duckdb`** from the monthly **World Register
of Marine Species** Darwin Core Archive downloaded from
[marinespecies.org/download](https://www.marinespecies.org/download/). Run this whenever a
newer download is dropped in `{dir_raw}/marinespecies.org/WoRMS_download_<YYYY-MM-DD>/`; it
is **version-tracked** (a `worms_meta` row records the loaded download date) and idempotent
— it rebuilds only when the latest download on disk is newer than what is loaded (or
`REDO_WORMS=1`).

**Why this source (not checklistbank / GBIF):** the marinespecies.org DwC-A is the
authoritative WoRMS export and carries the `isMarine`/`isBrackish`/… habitat flags. It is
updated monthly. **AlgaeBase-sourced taxa (macroalgae/seagrass) are license-excluded** from
this (and every redistributable) WoRMS download, so ~hundreds of algae used by our SDM
datasets are absent here — `merge_taxon.qmd` fills those on demand from the **WoRMS REST
API** (`worrms::wm_record`) and caches them in `data/worms_taxonomy_supplement.csv`.

## Two sources (v11 Q1): `WORMS_SOURCE`

`WORMS_SOURCE=download` (the default, `libs/vars.R`) is everything above and below, unchanged: the monthly DwC-A.

`WORMS_SOURCE=obisindicators` builds the same `worms` table from `worms_taxon.parquet` of the
[obisindicators](https://github.com/marinebon/obisindicators) release `OBIS_H3_RELEASE` (default `v20261012`) —
the WoRMS taxonomy that the OBIS store's `aphiaid`s were joined against, so every v11 record count and the
taxonomy that classifies it come from one snapshot (`worms_version` in the release's `release.json`, recorded in
the manifest). The parquet is a superset of the download (1.58 M taxa against 0.60 M; it carries the AlgaeBase
taxa the license keeps out of the download, which makes `data/worms_taxonomy_supplement.csv` redundant) but
has six columns, the download 26, so the rest are **derived or carried**, never invented:

| column(s) of `worms` | from `worms_taxon.parquet` |
|---|---|
| `taxonID`, `acceptedNameUsageID`, `parentNameUsageID`, `scientificName`, `taxonRank`, `taxonomicStatus` | as is |
| `scientificNameID` | `taxonID` (the download's LSID number is the AphiaID; equal for all 596,103 rows) |
| `acceptedNameUsage`, `parentNameUsage` | the `scientificName` of the row `acceptedNameUsageID` / `parentNameUsageID` names |
| `kingdom`, `phylum`, `class`, `order`, `family`, `genus`, `subgenus` | walking `parentNameUsageID` from the roots (`phylum` takes rank `Phylum` or `Phylum (Division)`, as the download does for algae, plants and fungi; a synonym takes its parent's classification) |
| `specificEpithet`, `infraspecificEpithet` | the 2nd / 3rd word of the name without its `(Subgenus)`, for species and below |
| `isMarine`, `isFreshwater`, `isTerrestrial`, `isExtinct`, `isBrackish` | **not in the parquet**: carried by `taxonID` from the last real DwC-A download (`worms_habitat`, captured from the `worms` table the first time this runs after a download); NULL for a taxon that download did not have |
| `scientificNameAuthorship`, `nomenclaturalCode`, `nomenclaturalStatus` | **NULL** (not in the parquet; nothing in the pipeline reads them except a display column in `ingest_swfsc_cce.qmd`) |

Measured against the 2026-07-01 download on the 596,077 taxa both hold (same 26 columns, order and types):
kingdom, phylum and genus agree on 100.00 %, class and subgenus on 99.99 %, family on 99.74 %, order on 99.32 %
(the differences are WoRMS reclassifications between July and October, e.g. Doridida → Nudibranchia,
Perciformes → Acanthuriformes), `acceptedNameUsage` / `parentNameUsage` on 99.7 % / 99.9 %, `specificEpithet` on
99.9 % and `infraspecificEpithet` on 97.6 %. 329 of the 1.58 M taxa have no Kingdom-rank ancestor.

**The habitat flags are carried, not recomputed, and nothing live reads them from `spp.duckdb`:**
`merge_taxon.qmd`'s `worms_is_marine` comes from `merge_models_prep.qmd` (the previous version's `taxon` table),
and the only reader of `isExtinct` is a report table in `ingest_aquax.qmd`. 988,701 of the 1.58 M taxa carry NULL
flags (the download never held them); of v10's 26,056 worms-authority taxa 372 are NULL-or-absent under the
download and 372 under the parquet. The manifest records `habitat_flags_ver` (the download the flags come from) and
`n_flags_null`; a fresh download (`WORMS_SOURCE=download`) refreshes `worms_habitat` the next time this runs.

## Design

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-design
%%| fig-cap: "Latest WoRMS DwC-A → rebuilt `worms` taxonomy table with habitat flags, content-addressed manifest"
flowchart LR
  dwc["WoRMS DwC-A<br/>taxon.txt + speciesprofile.txt"] --> pick["pick latest<br/>WoRMS_download_&lt;date&gt;"]
  pick --> bld["CREATE TABLE worms<br/>(strip LSID, join isMarine/…)"]
  bld --> tbl[("worms table<br/>spp.duckdb")]
  tbl --> mf["hash_query(worms)<br/>→ content-addressed manifest"]
```

## Setup + locate the latest download

```{r}
#| label: setup

librarian::shelf(DBI, dplyr, duckdb, fs, glue, here, jsonlite, logger, readr, stringr, quiet = T)
source(here("libs/paths.R"))   # spp_db, dir_raw, obis_h3_*
source(here("libs/vars.R"))    # worms_source: "download" (default) | "obisindicators" (v11 Q1)
manifest <- here("data/manifests/ingest_worms.json"); dir_create(path_dir(manifest))
redo     <- nzchar(Sys.getenv("REDO_WORMS"))

if (worms_source == "download") {
  # newest WoRMS_download_<date> folder holding the DwC-A core + speciesprofile
  dl_root <- glue("{dir_raw}/marinespecies.org")
  dls <- dir_ls(dl_root, type = "directory", regexp = "WoRMS_download_\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$")
  stopifnot("no WoRMS_download_<date> folder found" = length(dls) > 0)
  dl_dir   <- dls[order(path_file(dls))] |> tail(1)                    # latest by name (date)
  worms_ver <- str_extract(path_file(dl_dir), "\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}")
  taxon_txt <- glue("{dl_dir}/taxon.txt")
  sprof_txt <- glue("{dl_dir}/speciesprofile.txt")
  stopifnot(all(file_exists(c(taxon_txt, sprof_txt))))
  src_label <- path_file(dl_dir)                                       # what worms_meta.source records
  log_info("latest WoRMS download: {path_file(dl_dir)} (version {worms_ver})")
} else {
  # the WoRMS of an obisindicators release (OBIS_H3_RELEASE): local folder, else HTTPS
  source(here("libs/obis_h3.R"))
  info      <- obis_h3_info()
  worms_ver <- info$worms_version
  src_label <- glue("obisindicators:{info$release}")
  wt_src    <- obis_h3_src("worms_taxon.parquet")
  log_info("WoRMS {worms_ver} from obisindicators release {info$release} (OBIS {info$obis_snapshot}), ",
           "{if (wt_src$remote) 'over HTTPS' else 'local folder'}")
}
```

## Fetch a fresh monthly download (procedure)

The [WoRMS download](https://www.marinespecies.org/download/) is **login-gated and
request-based** (there is no stable "latest" URL): sign in, request a full Darwin Core
Archive, and download the generated zip. It cannot be reliably scripted end-to-end, so the
monthly refresh is: **download → unzip into `WoRMS_download_<YYYY-MM-DD>/` → run this
notebook** (it auto-detects the newest folder).

Credentials live outside git in `{dir_private}/…marinespecies.org_<user>.txt` (password
only; username is `ben@ecoquants.com`). The chunk below is a **best-effort** helper (kept
`eval: false`) — if WoRMS changes to expose a direct authenticated archive URL, wire it here.

```{r}
#| label: download
#| eval: false

# username + password (password file is the plain secret; never commit it)
dir_private <- ifelse(Sys.info()[["sysname"]] == "Linux", "/share/private", "~/My Drive/private")
pw_txt <- Sys.glob(path.expand(glue("{dir_private}/*marinespecies.org_*.txt")))[1]
worms_user <- "ben@ecoquants.com"
worms_pass <- readr::read_file(pw_txt) |> trimws()
# NOTE: marinespecies.org serves the DwC-A via a login + request flow, not a static URL.
# Do the request in the browser, then unzip into
#   {dir_raw}/marinespecies.org/WoRMS_download_<YYYY-MM-DD>/
# and re-run this notebook. (Placeholder for a future authenticated-URL fetch.)
```

## (Re)build the `worms` table

```{r}
#| label: build

con <- dbConnect(duckdb(spp_db))
loaded <- tryCatch(
  dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT worms_ver FROM worms_meta ORDER BY built DESC LIMIT 1")$worms_ver,
  error = function(e) NA_character_)
# the source too: the same version string from another source is not "already loaded"
loaded_src <- tryCatch(
  dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT source FROM worms_meta ORDER BY built DESC LIMIT 1")$source,
  error = function(e) NA_character_)
habitat <- list(ver = NA_character_, n_null = NA_integer_)   # obisindicators path only (see manifest)

if (!redo && isTRUE(loaded == worms_ver) && isTRUE(loaded_src == src_label) && "worms" %in% dbListTables(con)) {
  log_info("worms table already at version {worms_ver} ({src_label}); skipping (REDO_WORMS=1 to force)")
} else if (worms_source == "obisindicators") {
  # v11 Q1: the table from worms_taxon.parquet of the release. Same columns and types as the DwC-A build
  # below; what the parquet lacks is derived (classification, names, epithets) or carried (habitat flags)
  # -- see "Two sources" above
  if (wt_src$remote) dbExecute(con, "INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;")
  wt <- wt_src$path

  # habitat flags are not in the parquet: keep them by taxonID from the last real DwC-A download.
  # (Re)captured whenever the table in place was built from a download, so a fresh download refreshes them.
  if (isTRUE(grepl("^WoRMS_download_", loaded_src)) && "worms" %in% dbListTables(con)) {
    dbExecute(con, glue("
      CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE worms_habitat AS
      SELECT taxonID, isMarine, isFreshwater, isTerrestrial, isExtinct, isBrackish, '{loaded}' AS flags_ver
      FROM worms"))
    log_info("habitat flags captured from the {loaded_src} table (worms_habitat)")
  }
  if (!"worms_habitat" %in% dbListTables(con)) {
    log_warn("no DwC-A download to take habitat flags from: isMarine & co will be NULL for every taxon, ",
             "and merge_taxon reads coalesce(worms_is_marine, TRUE)")
    dbExecute(con, "CREATE TABLE worms_habitat (taxonID BIGINT, isMarine BIGINT, isFreshwater BIGINT,
                    isTerrestrial BIGINT, isExtinct BIGINT, isBrackish BIGINT, flags_ver VARCHAR)")
  }

  # classification: walk parentNameUsageID from the roots, carrying the nearest ancestor of each rank
  anc <- function(col, ranks) {   # one ancestor column of the recursive step (class / order are SQL keywords: quoted)
    inr <- paste0("'", ranks, "'", collapse = ", ")
    glue("CASE WHEN c.taxonRank IN ({inr}) THEN c.scientificName ELSE p.\"{col}\" END AS \"{col}\"")
  }
  root <- function(col, ranks) {   # ... and of the anchor (the roots)
    inr <- paste0("'", ranks, "'", collapse = ", ")
    glue("CASE WHEN taxonRank IN ({inr}) THEN scientificName END AS \"{col}\"")
  }
  rk <- list(kingdom = "Kingdom", phylum = c("Phylum", "Phylum (Division)"), class = "Class",
             order = "Order", family = "Family", genus = "Genus", subgenus = "Subgenus")
  rk_root <- vapply(names(rk), \(k) as.character(root(k, rk[[k]])), "")
  rk_anc  <- vapply(names(rk), \(k) as.character(anc(k, rk[[k]])), "")
  nm_plain <- "regexp_replace(t.scientificName, '\\s*\\([^)]*\\)', '')"   # the name without its (Subgenus)
  dbExecute(con, glue("
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE worms AS
    WITH RECURSIVE
    t AS (SELECT taxonID, parentNameUsageID, acceptedNameUsageID, scientificName, taxonRank, taxonomicStatus
          FROM read_parquet('{wt}')),
    tr AS (
      SELECT taxonID, {paste(rk_root, collapse = ', ')}, 0 AS depth
      FROM t WHERE parentNameUsageID IS NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT c.taxonID, {paste(rk_anc, collapse = ', ')}, p.depth + 1
      FROM t c JOIN tr p ON c.parentNameUsageID = p.taxonID WHERE p.depth < 60)
    SELECT
      t.taxonID,
      t.taxonID                       AS scientificNameID,   -- the AphiaID; the DwC-A's LSID number is the same
      t.acceptedNameUsageID,
      t.parentNameUsageID,
      t.scientificName,
      a.scientificName                AS acceptedNameUsage,
      pa.scientificName               AS parentNameUsage,
      tr.kingdom, tr.phylum, tr.\"class\", tr.\"order\", tr.family, tr.genus, tr.subgenus,
      CASE WHEN t.taxonRank IN ('Species','Subspecies','Variety','Forma','Subvariety','Subforma')
           THEN nullif(split_part({nm_plain}, ' ', 2), '') END AS specificEpithet,
      CASE WHEN t.taxonRank IN ('Subspecies','Variety','Forma','Subvariety','Subforma')
           THEN nullif(split_part({nm_plain}, ' ', 3), '') END AS infraspecificEpithet,
      t.taxonRank,
      NULL::VARCHAR                   AS scientificNameAuthorship,
      NULL::VARCHAR                   AS nomenclaturalCode,
      t.taxonomicStatus,
      NULL::VARCHAR                   AS nomenclaturalStatus,
      h.isMarine, h.isFreshwater, h.isTerrestrial, h.isExtinct, h.isBrackish
    FROM t
    LEFT JOIN tr ON tr.taxonID = t.taxonID
    LEFT JOIN t a  ON a.taxonID  = t.acceptedNameUsageID
    LEFT JOIN t pa ON pa.taxonID = t.parentNameUsageID
    LEFT JOIN worms_habitat h ON h.taxonID = t.taxonID"))
  n_t  <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("SELECT count(*) n FROM read_parquet('{wt}')"))$n
  n_w  <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT count(*) n FROM worms")$n
  stopifnot("worms lost or duplicated taxa in the join chain" = n_w == n_t)
  n_nokingdom <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT count(*) n FROM worms WHERE kingdom IS NULL")$n
  habitat$ver    <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT max(flags_ver) v FROM worms_habitat")$v
  habitat$n_null <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT count(*) n FROM worms WHERE isMarine IS NULL")$n
  log_info("worms from obisindicators: {n_w} taxa; {n_nokingdom} without a kingdom (orphans / unclassified); ",
           "habitat flags from download {ifelse(is.na(habitat$ver), 'NONE', habitat$ver)}, {habitat$n_null} taxa without isMarine")

  for (ix in c("taxonID", "scientificNameID", "acceptedNameUsageID", "scientificName"))
    try(dbExecute(con, glue("CREATE INDEX worms_{ix}_idx ON worms ({ix})")), silent = TRUE)
  dbExecute(con, "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS worms_meta (worms_ver VARCHAR, n_rows BIGINT, source VARCHAR, built TIMESTAMP)")
  dbExecute(con, glue("INSERT INTO worms_meta VALUES ('{worms_ver}', {n_w}, '{src_label}', now())"))
  log_info("rebuilt worms: {n_w} rows from {src_label}")
} else {
  strip <- function(col) glue(
    "TRY_CAST(regexp_replace({col}, 'urn:lsid:marinespecies.org:taxname:', '') AS BIGINT)")
  dbExecute(con, glue("
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE worms AS
    WITH sp AS (
      SELECT {strip('taxonID')} AS taxonID, isMarine, isFreshwater, isTerrestrial,
             isExtinct, isBrackish
      FROM read_csv('{sprof_txt}', delim='\t', header=true, quote='\"', ignore_errors=true,
                    types={{'taxonID':'VARCHAR'}}))
    SELECT
      {strip('t.taxonID')}             AS taxonID,
      {strip('t.scientificNameID')}    AS scientificNameID,
      {strip('t.acceptedNameUsageID')} AS acceptedNameUsageID,
      {strip('t.parentNameUsageID')}   AS parentNameUsageID,
      t.scientificName, t.acceptedNameUsage, t.parentNameUsage,
      t.kingdom, t.phylum, t.\"class\", t.\"order\", t.family, t.genus, t.subgenus,
      t.specificEpithet, t.infraspecificEpithet, t.taxonRank, t.scientificNameAuthorship,
      t.nomenclaturalCode, t.taxonomicStatus, t.nomenclaturalStatus,
      sp.isMarine, sp.isFreshwater, sp.isTerrestrial, sp.isExtinct, sp.isBrackish
    FROM read_csv('{taxon_txt}', delim='\t', header=true, quote='\"', ignore_errors=true,
                  types={{'taxonID':'VARCHAR','scientificNameID':'VARCHAR',
                          'acceptedNameUsageID':'VARCHAR','parentNameUsageID':'VARCHAR'}}) t
    LEFT JOIN sp ON {strip('t.taxonID')} = sp.taxonID"))

  for (ix in c("taxonID", "scientificNameID", "acceptedNameUsageID", "scientificName"))
    try(dbExecute(con, glue("CREATE INDEX worms_{ix}_idx ON worms ({ix})")), silent = TRUE)

  n <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT count(*) n FROM worms")$n
  dbExecute(con, "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS worms_meta (worms_ver VARCHAR, n_rows BIGINT, source VARCHAR, built TIMESTAMP)")
  dbExecute(con, glue("INSERT INTO worms_meta VALUES ('{worms_ver}', {n}, '{src_label}', now())"))
  log_info("rebuilt worms: {n} rows from {src_label}")
}
```

## Verify

```{r}
#| label: verify

smry <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT count(*) n_rows,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE scientificNameID IS NOT NULL) n_aphia,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE isMarine) n_marine,
  count(DISTINCT kingdom) n_kingdoms FROM worms")
msens::report_table(smry, caption = "worms taxonomy table summary")
knitr::kable(dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT kingdom, count(*) n FROM worms GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 8"))
# AlgaeBase check: these should be ABSENT here (filled by the WoRMS API in merge_taxon)
alg <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT count(*) n FROM worms WHERE scientificName IN ('Caulerpa sertularioides','Ulva intestinalis')")$n
if (worms_source == "download") {
  log_info("AlgaeBase spot-check (expect 0, filled via API): {alg}")
} else {
  log_info("AlgaeBase spot-check (expect 2: the obisindicators WoRMS carries them, the supplement CSV is redundant): {alg}")
}
# content fingerprint of the worms table (before disconnect)
h <- msens::hash_query(con, "worms")
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

## Manifest

```{r}
#| label: manifest

# content-addressed manifest: deterministic (no wall-clock) -> downstream targets
# re-run only when the worms table's content actually changes
stats <- list(worms_ver = worms_ver, source = src_label,
              n_rows = smry$n_rows, n_marine = smry$n_marine)
if (worms_source != "download")   # the download path's manifest keeps exactly its four fields
  stats <- c(stats, list(worms_source = worms_source, obis_release = info$release, obis_snapshot = info$obis_snapshot,
                         habitat_flags_ver = habitat$ver, n_flags_null = habitat$n_null))
msens::write_manifest(
  manifest, target = "ingest_worms", content_hash = h,
  stats = stats,
  force = msens::force_target("ingest_worms"))
manifest
```
